name: Synthetic Camera
summary: Simulates a synthetic stereo camera rig (SynC) in orbit, streaming left and right image frames from Blender with ground-truth geometry.

scene.label: Scene directory
scene.description: Folder containing the scene generator script (build_ingress_scene.py) and rendered frame sequences.

camera.label: Camera optics profile
camera.description: Camera profile from camera_spec/ (e.g. Blackfly 12mm narrow FOV vs See3CAM 2.8mm wide FOV).

start.label: Start range (m)
start.description: Initial approach distance along optical axis.

stop.label: End range (m)
stop.description: Terminal approach distance along optical axis.

increment.label: Maximum distance step per pair (m)
increment.description: Maximum spatial step between successive stereo pairs. Both endpoints are included; the actual evenly spaced step can be smaller.

sunAzimuth.label: Sun azimuth angle (deg)
sunAzimuth.description: Azimuth is measured from +Y toward +X. Since cameras look along +Y, 180 degrees places the Sun behind the camera.

sunElevation.label: Sun elevation angle (deg)
sunElevation.description: Solar elevation angle above the target horizon.

fps.label: Stream FPS
fps.description: Playback frame rate for the workflow.

loop.label: Loop sequence
loop.description: When checked, wraps back to start after reaching the terminal frame.

regenerate.label: Re-render in Blender before running
regenerate.description: Required for changed scene, range, or sun settings to affect images. If unchecked, existing rendered frames are reused.
